name: Scharbeutz (Germany)
description: Gyronny of sixteen white and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Scharbeutz (a blue bear's head on yellow).
history: The flag was approved on 11 July 1984; the cloth is gyronny of sixteen white and red and charged at the centre with a yellow shield with a blue bear's head.

features.role: gyronny of sixteen red and white rays
